epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local full stack startup time from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack startup
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose configuration, so that the full stack can be started with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository without a docker-compose file,
When I run docker-compose up,
Then the full stack starts successfully and tests verify the health-check endpoint returns 200 OK.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local environment startup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to correct an outdated material from >1 hour to <1 minute
requirements: R1: Add update and delete capabilities to the existing epidemiological material management UI

slices.title: Add update and delete actions to material management UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions to the existing frontend, so that materials can be maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI,
When the user clicks edit and submits changes, or clicks delete,
Then the frontend sends a PUT or DELETE request to the API, and E2E tests verify the view updates.
slices.tocConstraintRef: frontend UI actions for material mutation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase frontend update and delete API call test coverage from 0% to 100%

epics.title: Authentication and Access Control
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from unknown to 0
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication and session management for catalog access and material creation

slices.title: Enforce authentication for catalog routes
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to patch existing backend routes and frontend guards to require authentication, so that restricted endpoints are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access restricted catalog endpoints,
Then they are blocked with a 401 response, and integration tests verify authenticated users are granted access.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase authentication middleware test coverage on protected routes from 0% to 100%
